title: 29 CFR 1910.147 — The control of hazardous energy (lockout/tagout)
publisher: Occupational Safety and Health Administration, U.S. Department of Labor
locator: Paragraphs (b)–(f): scope and definitions, energy-control program and procedures, application/removal of lockout or tagout devices, release from lockout/tagout, and periodic inspection.
notes: U.S. federal occupational-safety regulation. Cited as a jurisdiction-specific example for hazardous-energy control in applicable servicing/maintenance work; applicability must be determined for the workplace and task. Does not replace local law, site risk assessment, or machine-specific OEM procedures.
